SELECT sat.rtype, typeof(sat.AvgScrMath) AS score_type,
       COUNT(*) AS score_rows, COUNT(sch.CDSCode) AS matched_rows,
       COUNT(sch.School) AS named_school_rows, MAX(sat.AvgScrMath) AS max_score
FROM satscores AS sat
LEFT JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds
GROUP BY sat.rtype, typeof(sat.AvgScrMath)
